facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Experimental schema selection is an explicit generator argument, not an ambient repository feature gate.

invariants.statement: Checked-in JSON Schema and TypeScript fixtures must match the protocol source generator consumed by the app server and Desktop clients.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Transport configuration is resolved before this shared runtime entrypoint is invoked.
facet_exclusions.control_and_data_flow: This owner is a runtime boundary; request-to-core control flow is declared by its caller and consumer relationships.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: Protocol generation is owned separately by app-server-protocol-contracts.

invariants.statement: Every enabled app-server transport enters the shared runtime and preserves protocol-compatible request dispatch.

facet_exclusions.callers_and_consumers: The installed launcher boundary is documented in SOURCEMAP.md; this slice starts at the Rust main entrypoint.
facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Top-level subcommand dispatch is selected by parsed CLI input rather than a repository feature gate.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: The CLI dispatch owner does not generate a checked-in contract.

invariants.statement: A parsed top-level subcommand is dispatched to exactly one owning runtime entrypoint.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Code-mode protocol behavior is selected by its callers rather than repository configuration owned by this crate.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: Tool declarations are rendered at runtime and have no checked-in generated mirror.

invariants.statement: Rendered code-mode tool descriptions preserve callable names, schemas, runtime metadata, and bounded lazy-discovery guidance consumed by the host and core runtime.
Only the explicit canonical command launches whole-repository validation; the compiled CompletionProofGate verifies its current artifact without launching validation.
Every evolving inventory and replacement identity reconciles against the immutable V1 frozen inventory and replacement ledger rather than losing a baseline test through discovery drift.
Python inventory validation and the production-dormant Rust contract crate accept the same canonical vectors and bind the same schema resources.
Checked-in configuration schema and thread-config protobuf outputs must match their exact source generators and remain usable through their production consumers.

facet_exclusions.control_and_data_flow: Core contains many task-specific flows; select a narrower owner such as planning-architecture-runtime or tool-output-recovery before mutation.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: Generated contracts consumed by core are owned by their protocol or configuration generators.

invariants.statement: Model tool calls are dispatched through the registry/router contract rather than invoking handlers directly.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Relay protobuf parity is selected by its explicit generator check command rather than an ambient repository feature gate.

invariants.statement: The checked-in exec-server relay protobuf binding must match its exact source proto and remain connected to the production relay module.

facet_exclusions.control_and_data_flow: This owner defines feature identity and defaults; runtime behavior is controlled by consuming owners.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: The feature registry is source-backed and has no checked-in generated mirror.

invariants.statement: Persisted feature identifiers remain stable and unknown or retired identifiers fail safely.

facet_exclusions.control_and_data_flow: The checker validates a declarative inventory; individual capability runtime flows remain with their implementation owners.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: The capability inventory is authored source and has no checked-in generated mirror.

invariants.statement: Every declared KD4 capability has valid lifecycle metadata and repository-contained evidence, while optional runtime feature links resolve against the canonical Rust feature registry.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Model metadata and local prompt overrides are resolved by the manager; remote model availability configuration is outside this owner.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: Local prompt overrides are authored Rust inputs rather than generated artifacts.

invariants.statement: Each resolved model receives the intended base instructions and metadata without duplicating or dropping prompt contracts across local and remote catalog paths.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Checklist state is session-local runtime state, not a repository or feature configuration gate.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: The update_plan schema is constructed at runtime and has no checked-in generated mirror.

invariants.statement: Accepted plan updates commit to the session checklist before the tool response is emitted; cancellation before the commit boundary emits no plan update.

facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: The dormant admission layer owns no checked-in generated mirror; its projection is written only to a caller-selected path.

invariants.statement: Replacement admission validates or writes a caller-selected projection but does not mutate the V2 inventory, ledger, or completion-proof result.

Nonempty admissions require an exact caller-supplied successor catalog; the dormant validator does not authenticate currentness or infer, normalize, or manufacture successor identities from predecessor hints.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Discovery is driven by the active cwd and filesystem snapshot rather than a feature gate.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: Repository metadata and instruction results are runtime cache entries, not checked-in generated artifacts.

invariants.statement: Repository identity and AGENTS.md results are keyed by the relevant workspace snapshot so nested roots and prior read failures cannot silently reuse unrelated evidence.

facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: SOURCEMAP.md and architecture_index.json are generated by source-owner-index; these runners only validate or orchestrate their source inputs.

invariants.statement: Supported maintenance recipes use the configured just shell adapter, canonical validation specifications reach the exact repository runners and their declared ownership or Rust-selection inputs, and focused completion proof consumes those maintenance validation routes.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: The benchmark command selects a workflow directly; no repository feature or configuration file owns that selection.

invariants.statement: Code-mode capture emits one-build raw samples and a nested-dispatch quality verdict, while synthetic reports alone emit local baseline/candidate non-inferiority verdicts.
Only hash-valid, complete, uncapped, passing batch and final A/B reports enter the tracked accepted-report mirror.
Live-agent reports bind each binary to a clean exact commit and tree, report outcome correctness separately from task-contract compliance, and retain structured diagnostic categories.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Shared protocol shape is a compatibility boundary and is not selected by a repository feature gate owned here.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: App-server schema mirrors are owned separately by app-server-protocol-contracts.

invariants.statement: Shared wire types, base instructions, rollouts, and stored-session representations remain compatible across core, CLI, app-server, and protocol consumers.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Utility behavior is selected through typed crate dependencies rather than repository feature gates.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: These utility crates are authored source and do not own generated mirrors.

invariants.statement: Cross-domain build metadata and DER boundary parsing each have one typed implementation and one directly owned unit-test contract.
SOURCEMAP.md and architecture_index.json are deterministic mirrors of the same validated manifest digest.

facet_exclusions.configuration_and_gates: Recovery limits are tool-schema and call arguments, not repository configuration or a feature gate.
facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: Output artifacts are immutable runtime state and are not checked-in generated files.

invariants.statement: An artifact selector either returns exact requested content or an explicit deterministic subdivision or omission receipt; it never silently clips exact values.

facet_exclusions.generated_artifacts: Workflow preflight writes task receipts and private Git-metadata registry state at runtime; it has no checked-in generated mirror.

invariants.statement: Both supported just recipes route through the workflow-preflight CLI, whose accepted manifest fields remain aligned with the harness template and whose claims, leases, registry behavior, and release path are exercised through the subprocess CLI tests.
